result.reason: The 30-day notice period and 60-day Vendor reminder match the preferred renewal mechanics, but the clause omits the required renewal price-increase cap, including the fallback 5% cap. In addition, inserting the reminder before “Such notice” makes that phrase appear to refer to the renewal reminder, improperly requiring the reminder to specify a Termination Date and obscuring the original termination-notice requirement. The edits are otherwise limited to the renewal provision.
